title: Self-Parking cars Tesla v Audi v Ford v BMW - test and comparison - are they any good?
summary: A hands-on comparison of self-parking systems on a Tesla Model S and 3 (including AP1 vs AP2), an Audi e-tron GT, a Ford Mustang Mach-E and a BMW i4 M50. It tests both parallel and perpendicular parking and finds Tesla's newer vision-based parking noticeably weaker than the others.
why: Cited repeatedly in Tesla threads as concrete side-by-side evidence that Tesla's self-parking lags other manufacturers, undercutting its full self-driving claims.

quote.text: All cars nailed the spots they tested flawlessly while the Tesla just straight up didn't see most of the spots.
